section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the analytic strategy for a single study examining relationships among body appreciation (BAS-2), BMI, external shame, and self-compassion. The analysis employed path analysis using SPSS and Amos software, with BAS-2 as the body appreciation measure and BMI as an exogenous variable. The study included 155 participants and conducted multigroup invariance analysis to test for differences between male and female participants.
